title: Automated coastal landcover classification workflow, New Zealand, 2022
sourceName: Remote Sensing (MDPI), volume 14, issue 19, article 4827, figure 4
credit: Benedict Collings, Murray Ford and Mark Dickson (2022), Remote Sensing 14(19), 4827, Figure 4, CC BY 4.0
altText: Multi-stage automated processing flow from New Zealand satellite image composites through rule-based masking and machine-learning classification.
caption: A documented 2022 University of Auckland coastal remote-sensing workflow combines satellite composites, rule-based processing and supervised classification into repeatable New Zealand mapping.
context: Figure 4 from Collings, Ford and Dickson (2022), using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery. Unlike a generic model-builder illustration, this documents a real New Zealand automated geospatial research workflow. It is not claimed to be an earlier NIWA or local-council processing workflow.
